title: A2A-T corpus output result format
description: Execution transcript written by the corpus engine for one scenario file. One file is a JSON array of result records; each record echoes the case metadata, aggregates per-case totals, and lists the full interaction transcript (SDK API steps interleaved with their underlying LLM calls). Content is always complete, never truncated.

result.description: success: every step matched its expectation; failure: at least one assertion did not match; error: the engine crashed on a step.

failReason.description: One-sentence pointer to the first unmet assertion, e.g. step2.data.accessPort.

interactions.description: Globally numbered transcript mixing SDK API steps (type = API method name) with their underlying LLM calls (type = LLM).
